items.expression_en: The white car parked on the road, positioned between a white van and a silver car.
items.gloss_zh: 停在路边、夹在白色面包车与银色轿车之间的白色汽车。

items.expression_en: the brown animal standing on the grass near the bottom of the frame
items.gloss_zh: 站在画面底部附近草地上的棕色动物。

items.expression_en: the building with the blue roof located in front of the white structure
items.gloss_zh: 位于白色建筑前方的蓝色屋顶建筑物。

items.expression_en: The bridge spanning the green water channel, featuring a row of vertical support pillars.
items.gloss_zh: 横跨绿色水道、下方带有一排竖直桥墩的桥梁。

items.expression_en: The flat-roofed structure situated between the dark corrugated roof on the left and the building with a white tank on the right.
items.gloss_zh: 位于左侧深色波纹屋顶与右侧带白色水箱建筑之间的平顶结构。

items.expression_en: The tricycle is black and white, with a person driving it. It is positioned on the left side of the image, near the bottom.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面左侧靠近底部、由人驾驶的黑白两色三轮车。

items.expression_en: the large white bus in the lower right area of the street, positioned below the row of parked cars
items.gloss_zh: 位于街道右下方、停放车辆排下方的大型白色公共汽车。

items.expression_en: The left of the two light-clothed riders on two-wheeled vehicles below the crosswalk.
items.gloss_zh: 位于人行横道下方、两名浅色衣物两轮车骑行者中左侧的一位。

items.expression_en: The motor is black and white, driven by a person, located near the center of the image, with a distinct pattern on its body.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面中央附近、由骑手驾驶且车身带有明显花纹的黑白两色摩托车。

items.expression_en: The bicycle is yellow and being ridden by a person near the bottom left corner of the image.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面左下角附近、正被人骑行的黄色自行车。

items.expression_en: The traffic light on the horizontal pole in the lower right, positioned to the left of its pair.
items.gloss_zh: 位于右下方横杆上、成对信号灯中左侧的那盏交通信号灯。

items.expression_en: the traffic sign with a red circular symbol on top and a blue square symbol below, located on the right side of the intersection
items.gloss_zh: 位于路口右侧、上方为红圈标志下方为蓝方标志的交通标志。

items.expression_en: The white boat is a small-sized vessel located near the center-left of the image.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面中左侧附近的小型白色船只。

items.expression_en: The boat is white and large, positioned near the top-left of the image, with a distinctive black top structure.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面左上方附近、顶部带有醒目黑色上层建筑的大型白色船舶。

items.expression_en: the illuminated pedestrian bridge with a wavy red roof spanning the road
items.gloss_zh: 夜间亮灯、带有红色波浪形顶棚并横跨道路的人行天桥。

items.expression_en: The small, standalone building with a pitched, tiled roof and light-colored stone walls, located next to the large tree and near the orange car.
items.gloss_zh: 毗邻大型建筑、带有坡面瓦顶与浅色石墙的小型独立建筑。

items.expression_en: A deer located in the open field near the corner of the grey-roofed building.
items.gloss_zh: 位于灰顶建筑转角附近开阔草地上的鹿。

items.expression_en: The leafy green tree growing in the open courtyard area, situated between the building with the blue roof and the lower rooftop with a white satellite dish.
items.gloss_zh: 生长在蓝顶建筑与周边房屋之间开阔庭院里的茂密绿树。

items.expression_en: the building with the reddish-brown roof located in the middle of the residential block, between the road and the houses to its right
items.gloss_zh: 位于住宅街区中部、介于道路与右侧房屋之间的红褐色屋顶建筑。

items.expression_en: The white car on the road near the underpass entrance in the lower-right part of the image.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面右下方下穿通道入口附近路面上的白色汽车。

items.expression_en: the white arched pedestrian bridge spanning the highway, featuring a yellow banner with red text along its side and elevated ramps on both ends
items.gloss_zh: 横跨公路的白色拱形人行天桥，桥侧挂有黄底红字横幅，两端带有高架引坡。

items.expression_en: The red box truck near the center of the image.
items.gloss_zh: 位于画面中央附近的红色厢式货车。

items.expression_en: the two-story house with a dark roof and dormer window, situated behind a long green hedge
items.gloss_zh: 位于长条绿篱后方、带有深色屋顶和老虎窗的两层住宅。

items.expression_en: the palm tree with yellowish-green fronds located at the edge of the red-tiled courtyard
items.gloss_zh: 位于红瓦庭院边缘、枝叶呈黄绿色的棕榈树。
